scenarios.title: A｜确认时间
scenarios.setting: 玩家和朋友几天前约好了周六见面，现在发消息确认。

turns.prompt: 你想确认之前约好的计划是否照常，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey! Are we still on for Saturday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! Are we still on for Saturday?
feedback.explanation: “Are we still on for …?”用于确认原定约会是否照常，突出已有约定。

choices.text: Just checking—are we still meeting tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just checking—are we still meeting tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Hey, just wanted to confirm we’re still good for 2 tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just wanted to confirm we’re still good for 2 tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: We’re still meeting at 2, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: We’re still meeting at 2, right?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Do we still meet tomorrow?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! Are we still on for Saturday?
feedback.explanation: 确认已有约定通常说“Are we still on for tomorrow?”；“Do we still meet”更像固定习惯。

turns.text: Yep! 2 pm at the café, right?

turns.prompt: 你想核对双方约定的见面时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yep, that’s what I have too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yep, that’s what I have too.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: Exactly. See you there!

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. See you there!
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

choices.text: Yep! I’ll probably get there a few minutes early.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yep! I’ll probably get there a few minutes early.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Actually, I thought we said 2:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I thought we said 2:30.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Haha, glad we checked. See you at 2:30!

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha, glad we checked. See you at 2:30!
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Perfect. 2:30 it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. 2:30 it is.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Great, I’ll see you then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, I’ll see you then.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜修改计划
scenarios.setting: 玩家原本约好晚上七点吃饭，但临时需要晚一点。

turns.prompt: 你想商量把见面时间稍微推后，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, would you mind if we pushed dinner back a little?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, would you mind if we pushed dinner back a little?
feedback.explanation: “would you mind if”征求对方对某个安排是否介意，后面接完整从句；与“mind + -ing”的结构不同。

choices.text: Any chance we could meet at 7:30 instead of 7?

feedback.naturalExpression: Any chance we could meet at 7:30 instead of 7?
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

choices.text: Something came up. Would 7:30 work for you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Something came up. Would 7:30 work for you?
feedback.explanation: “something came up”在临时安排中表示出现了事情，常用于简短解释为什么要改约。

choices.text: Sorry for the late notice, but could we make it 7:30?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the late notice, but could we make it 7:30?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Can we change our meeting to more late?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, would you mind if we pushed dinner back a little?
feedback.explanation: 应为 meet later / push it back。

turns.text: Yeah, 7:30 should be fine. Everything okay?

turns.prompt: 你想解释需要调整计划的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, all good! Work’s just taking longer than I expected.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, all good! Work’s just taking longer than I expected.
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。

choices.text: Nothing serious. I’m just running behind.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nothing serious. I’m just running behind.
feedback.explanation: “running behind”表示进度落后于原计划，可用于解释为什么需要调整时间。

choices.text: Yeah, sorry about that. I’ll definitely be there by 7:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, sorry about that. I’ll definitely be there by 7:30.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for being flexible!

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for being flexible!
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Appreciate it. See you at 7:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: Appreciate it. See you at 7:30.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

choices.text: Perfect, I’ll text you when I’m on my way.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, I’ll text you when I’m on my way.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜取消计划
scenarios.setting: 玩家临时无法参加晚上和朋友的约会。

turns.prompt: 你想说明临时无法赴约，并表达歉意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, I’m really sorry, but I don’t think I can make it tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I’m really sorry, but I don’t think I can make it tonight.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’m so sorry, but something came up and I need to cancel tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m so sorry, but something came up and I need to cancel tonight.
feedback.explanation: “something came up”在临时安排中表示出现了事情，常用于简短解释为什么要改约。

choices.text: I hate to do this last minute, but can we take a rain check?

feedback.naturalExpression: I hate to do this last minute, but can we take a rain check?
feedback.explanation: “take a rain check”表示这次先不参加、希望改天再约；开头也承认临时变动给对方带来不便。

choices.text: Sorry for the late notice. Would you mind if we rescheduled?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the late notice. Would you mind if we rescheduled?
feedback.explanation: “would you mind if”征求对方对某个安排是否介意，后面接完整从句；与“mind + -ing”的结构不同。

choices.text: Sorry, I can’t go to our plan tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I’m really sorry, but I don’t think I can make it tonight.
feedback.explanation: “go to our plan”搭配不成立；不能赴约可说“I can’t make it tonight”。

turns.text: Aw, okay. Is everything all right?

turns.prompt: 你想简单说明取消计划的原因，让对方放心，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, everything’s fine. I’m just completely exhausted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, everything’s fine. I’m just completely exhausted.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Yeah, don’t worry. Something at work came up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, don’t worry. Something at work came up.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Nothing serious! I just can’t get away tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nothing serious! I just can’t get away tonight.
feedback.explanation: 先说明没有严重的事，再说今晚脱不开身，减少对方不必要的担心。

choices.text: Yeah, I’m okay. Sorry again for canceling so late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m okay. Sorry again for canceling so late.
feedback.explanation: 点明自己为什么致歉，比只说一句“sorry”更能让对方知道问题已被理解。

turns.text: No worries. We can do another day.

turns.prompt: 关于「确认计划」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Definitely. How about sometime next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Definitely. How about sometime next week?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Thanks for understanding. I’ll make it up to you!

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding. I’ll make it up to you!
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

choices.text: Are you free next Saturday instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you free next Saturday instead?
feedback.explanation: 先确认对方是否方便，再进入正题，适合需要占用对方时间时开场。

choices.text: I’ll text you tomorrow and we’ll figure out another time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll text you tomorrow and we’ll figure out another time.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。
